title: Snake with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='bodyGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#4caf50'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#2e7d32'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bellyGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#a5d6a7'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#81c784'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- Snake body: a winding S-curve -->
  <path d='M20,82 C20,65 45,68 45,55 C45,42 22,42 22,32 C22,22 40,18 52,20 C64,22 72,30 72,40'
        fill='none' stroke='url(#bodyGrad)' stroke-width='16' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Belly stripe on body -->
  <path d='M20,82 C20,65 45,68 45,55 C45,42 22,42 22,32 C22,22 40,18 52,20 C64,22 72,30 72,40'
        fill='none' stroke='url(#bellyGrad)' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-dasharray='2 6'/>
  <!-- Tail tip -->
  <path d='M20,82 L14,88' stroke='#388e3c' stroke-width='10' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='38' rx='14' ry='11' fill='#66bb6a'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='38' rx='14' ry='11' fill='none' stroke='#81c784' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Snout bump -->
  <ellipse cx='88' cy='36' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#4caf50'/>
  <!-- Nostrils -->
  <circle cx='91' cy='34' r='1.2' fill='#1b5e20'/>
  <circle cx='91' cy='38' r='1.2' fill='#1b5e20'/>
  <!-- Sparkly eyes -->
  <circle cx='74' cy='33' r='5' fill='#fff59d'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='33' r='3' fill='#1b5e20'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='32' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='35' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Sparkles around eyes -->
  <path d='M69,26 L70.5,29 L73.5,29 L71,31 L72,34 L69,32 L66,34 L67,31 L64.5,29 L67.5,29 Z' fill='#fff176'/>
  <path d='M80,24 L81,26.5 L83.5,26.5 L81.5,28 L82.2,30.5 L80,29 L77.8,30.5 L78.5,28 L76.5,26.5 L79,26.5 Z' fill='#fff176'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='30' r='0.9' fill='#ffee58'/>
  <circle cx='83' cy='33' r='0.9' fill='#ffee58'/>
  <!-- Tongue -->
  <path d='M92,40 L96,44 M96,44 L98,41 M96,44 L98,47' stroke='#e91e63' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
</svg>
